current.text: He tore his Achilles in the playoffs. He is out until at least about March and may come back on a minutes limit.
He will miss most of the season and will not matter in any fantasy league. Do not draft him.

durable.text: Torn Achilles in the playoffs before the 2026-27 season.
His fantasy value depends on getting minutes and decent usage.
One expert says he shoots well fairly consistently.

tags.name: minutes limit
tags.detail: Expected to be on a minutes limit when he returns around March

note: Do not spend any of our 144 draft spots on him. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD (ranks 255 and 348), and he went for 1 USD in our last auction, before the Achilles tear. If he comes back around March, it will be on a minutes limit, just before our playoff weeks 19 to 21. His FG% was only 40.6% on 10.2 attempts last season, so all he offers is threes. Track his recovery news in February as a waiver option, not as a draft pick.
